question: Should OpenClaw add a persisted `tools.exec.shell` override, and what exact shell/args, WSL path/PATH, validation, PTY/sandbox/node, approval, and safe-bin contract should it use?
rationale: The requested config knob changes the command execution boundary and cannot be safely designed from the feature request alone without maintainer product and security intent.

options.title: Approve a scoped design first
options.body: Keep this issue open and require a maintainer-owned design for the shell override contract before any implementation PR lands.

options.title: Reject arbitrary shell override
options.body: Close the broad config request and keep solving concrete Windows shell bugs through narrower default-resolution fixes.

options.title: Accept a limited experimental knob
options.body: Allow an opt-in shell override only for explicitly trusted gateway hosts with validation and documented unsupported WSL semantics.

recommendation.title: Approve a scoped design first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and require a maintainer-owned design for the shell override contract before any implementation PR lands.

likelyOwner.reason: The current shell/config/runtime blame points to Peter's recent work and this choice crosses core exec security policy.
